news.headline: NKTR Reiterated by HC Wainwright & Co. -- Price Target Maintained at $185
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and $185 target a day after the alopecia areata durability data triggered a ~21% selloff.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Shares Drop After Rezpegaldesleukin Trial Results on Alopecia Areata
news.summary: Shares fell about 21% to ~$47.90 after the REZOLVE-AA update showed 75% of patients kept SALT <=20 at week 52 but only 63% six months after stopping treatment.

news.headline: Jefferies Analyst Defends Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Amid 21% Stock Drop on Rezpegaldesleukin Data
news.summary: Jefferies called the selloff unwarranted and reaffirmed Buy with a $150 target, citing the large alopecia areata opportunity.

news.headline: William Blair Reaffirms Outperform on Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Amid Rezpeg Data Advances
news.summary: William Blair kept Outperform and flagged an important atopic dermatitis data update expected in Q1 2027.

news.headline: Nektar Reports Durable Rezpegaldesleukin Data In Alopecia Areata And Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: At EADV 2026, 75% of alopecia areata patients kept a SALT score <=20 four months off treatment and 63% at six months. Atopic dermatitis responses deepened through 52 weeks with monthly and quarterly maintenance dosing.

news.headline: Nektar presents early biomarker data for eczema drug at EADV 2026
news.summary: At EADV 2026 in Vienna, Nektar showed multi-omic biomarker data from the Phase 2b atopic dermatitis study: molecular changes as early as Week 2 tracked with clinical response at Week 16. The findings support the planned Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar awarded $90 million in Lilly rezpeg dispute
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith in the rezpegaldesleukin license and awarded Nektar $90M, far below the $1B sought. Post-trial motions and appeals remain possible.

catalysts.label: Post-trial motions / appeal in Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: A jury awarded Nektar $90M on Sept 24, 2026 for Lilly's breach of the implied covenant of good faith (well below the $1B sought), sending shares up ~15%; the court still must set interest, and the verdict is subject to post-trial motions and possible appeal by either side.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Company is preparing the ~850-patient ZENITH AA Phase 3, targeted to start in early 2027, following the durability readout.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third global Phase 3 ZENITH AD study (treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) guided to start in September 2026, following ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 initiation in July 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline data from the Phase 3 registrational atopic dermatitis program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly earnings update on cash runway (>$1B as of June 30, 2026) and pipeline progress.

catalysts.label: Atopic dermatitis data update
catalysts.detail: William Blair flags an important atopic dermatitis data update expected in Q1 2027.

pulse: Nektar shares fell about 21% to ~$47.90 on Oct 1, 2026 after REZOLVE-AA durability data at EADV showed 63% of patients still at SALT <=20 six months off treatment (75% at week 52), erasing the gains from the $90M Lilly jury verdict of Sept 24. Jefferies (Buy, $150) and William Blair (Outperform) defended the stock, and the company, with roughly $1B in cash, is preparing the Phase 3 ZENITH AA start in early 2027 alongside the ongoing ZENITH AD program.
